errors.name: UnauthorizedLedgerWriter
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a caller is not authorized to write ledger state.

errors.name: InvalidLedgerWriter
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when the owner tries to configure an invalid writer.

errors.name: InvalidPhasePolicy
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a phase policy registration or lookup is invalid.

errors.name: InvalidCounterPolicy
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a counter policy is invalid or unsupported for launch.

errors.name: DuplicateCounterPolicy
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a phase policy repeats a counter ID.

errors.name: CounterPolicyLengthMismatch
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when counter ID and counter policy arrays differ in length.

errors.name: CounterPolicyNotRegistered
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a consumed counter has no registered policy.

errors.name: CounterPolicyMismatch
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a consumed counter does not match its registered policy.

errors.name: CounterValueKeyMismatch
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a supplied value key does not match the ledger key derivation.

errors.name: CounterCapExceeded
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a static counter increment would exceed its cap.

errors.name: CounterValueOverflow
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a counter increment would overflow uint64 storage.

errors.name: AuthorizationAlreadyConsumed
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when an authorization ID has already been consumed.

errors.name: NullifierAlreadyConsumed
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a nullifier has already been consumed.

errors.name: InvalidPolicyGrace
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a phase policy grace deadline is invalid.

errors.name: OperationRootRequired
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a batch operation root is zero.

errors.name: OperationRootAlreadyConsumed
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a manager already consumed a batch operation root.

events.name: MintLedgerWriterUpdated
events.natspec: @notice Emitted when the owner enables or disables a ledger writer.

events.name: MintLedgerPhasePolicyRegistered
events.natspec: @notice Emitted when a manager registers a phase policy hash.

events.name: MintLedgerCounterPolicyRegistered
events.natspec: @notice Emitted for each counter policy registered under a phase policy.

events.name: MintLedgerCounterConsumed
events.natspec: @notice Emitted when a registered counter value is incremented.

events.name: MintLedgerCounterConsumptionContext
events.natspec: @notice Emitted with non-indexed context for reconstructing a counter increment.

events.name: MintLedgerAuthorizationConsumed
events.natspec: @notice Emitted when an authorization ID is consumed.

events.name: MintLedgerNullifierConsumed
events.natspec: @notice Emitted when a manager consumes a nullifier.

events.name: MintLedgerOperationRootConsumed
events.natspec: @notice Emitted exactly once when a manager consumes a batch operation root.

events.name: MintLedgerPolicyGraceSet
events.natspec: @notice Emitted when a policy rotation records or clears predecessor grace.

functions.name: setLedgerWriter
functions.natspec: @notice Enables or disables a deployed manager contract as an authorized ledger writer.

functions.name: ledgerWriter
functions.natspec: @notice Returns whether an address may register and consume ledger state.

functions.name: registerPhasePolicy
functions.natspec: @notice Registers one launch-static phase policy for the calling manager.

functions.name: consume
functions.natspec: @notice Consumes one manager-scoped operation root and its accounting facts.

functions.name: registeredPhasePolicyHash
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the registered policy hash for a manager phase.

functions.name: registeredCounterPolicy
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the registered static policy for one manager phase counter.

functions.name: counterValue
functions.natspec:
@notice Returns the durable uint64 value for one ledger counter key.
 @dev Counter values are not reset by phase policy re-registration.

functions.name: deriveCounterValueKey
functions.natspec: @notice Derives the canonical value key for a manager counter subject.

functions.name: isManagerAuthorizationUsed
functions.natspec: @notice Returns whether a manager has already consumed an authorization ID.

functions.name: isManagerNullifierUsed
functions.natspec: @notice Returns whether a manager has already consumed a nullifier.

functions.name: isManagerOperationRootUsed
functions.natspec: @notice Returns whether a manager has already consumed an operation root.

functions.name: policyGrace
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the immediate predecessor grace tuple for a manager phase.

definition.name: IStreamMintLedger
definition.natspec: @notice Durable outside-Core accounting ledger for launch mint counters.
